tagline: 尼康胶片相机，1962 年发布
description: 尼康于1962年推出的胶片相机。快门速度1/1000th-1 second, B。

specs.快门: Copal Square vertical travel metal-blind mechanical focal-plane shutter
specs.曝光测光: Manual, designed to use clip-on accessory meter.

specs.英文简介: Nikkorex F, made by Mamiya for Nikon, also sold as Nikkor J.
